targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rotation_window) as value FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_rotation_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as rotation_window, COUNT(*) as rotation_count FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND location IN ($location) AND last_rotation_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rotation_window HAVING rotation_count >= 5) cycles;

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
